name: TriviumDB
author: DJLegends
description: Embedded vector, knowledge-graph, BM25 full-text and TQL database engine (TriviumDB 0.9.0) for other Project Σ extensions, through triviumdb.* commands (open, search, query, embed, rank), with TauriTavern's database API for ported extensions. Its view is a debug workbench with a meaning test for embedding connections.
